/* selectMonsterList */ SELECT m.monster_id , m.kr_name , m.un_name , m.monster_elemental , CAST(m.star AS INTEGER) AS star , m.image_url AS image_url , m2.kr_name AS modified_kr_name , m.arousal_type , m.archetype , m.awaken_bonus , CAST(m.skill_ups_to_max AS INTEGER) AS skill_ups_to_max , CAST(m.com2us_id AS INTEGER) AS com2us_id , CAST(m.awakens_from_id AS INTEGER) AS awakens_from_id , CAST(m.awakens_to_id AS INTEGER) AS awakens_to_id , CAST(m.family_id AS INTEGER) AS family_id , m.obtainable , m.usg_yn FROM monster m LEFT JOIN monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = SUBSTR(m.monster_id, 1, 3) || '0' || SUBSTR(m.monster_id, 5) WHERE m.usg_yn = 'Y' AND m.obtainable IS TRUE -- 변신 전용 행 제외: transforms_to_id만 있고 깨우침 연결(awakens_*)이 없는 레코드(예: 유니콘 변신체). -- monster_id/family_id 숫자로 거르지 않음. AND NOT ( m.transforms_to_id IS NOT NULL AND m.awakens_from_id IS NULL AND m.awakens_to_id IS NULL )
AND NOT ( COALESCE(CAST(m.awaken_level AS INTEGER), 0) = 1 AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM monster m2 WHERE m2.usg_yn = 'Y' AND m2.obtainable IS TRUE AND NOT ( m2.transforms_to_id IS NOT NULL AND m2.awakens_from_id IS NULL AND m2.awakens_to_id IS NULL ) AND COALESCE(CAST(m2.awaken_level AS INTEGER), 0) >= 2 AND m.family_id IS NOT NULL AND m2.family_id = m.family_id AND m2.monster_elemental IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.monster_elemental ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM monster m2 WHERE m2.usg_yn = 'Y' AND m2.obtainable IS TRUE AND NOT ( m2.transforms_to_id IS NOT NULL AND m2.awakens_from_id IS NULL AND m2.awakens_to_id IS NULL ) AND COALESCE(CAST(m2.awaken_level AS INTEGER), 0) >= 2 AND m.awakens_to_id IS NOT NULL AND m2.com2us_id = m.awakens_to_id ) ) )
ORDER BY m.monster_id ASC
ORDER BY -- Normal 먼저, Awakened 다음 (NULL·빈값은 Normal 취급) CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(m.arousal_type, ''))) = 'awakened' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, COALESCE(CAST(m.awaken_level AS INTEGER), 0) ASC, CAST(m.star AS INTEGER) ASC, m.monster_id ASC

select a.monster_id_1 || '-' || a.monster_id_2 || '-' || a.monster_id_3 as key , a.monster_id_1, a.monster_id_2, a.monster_id_3 , m1.image_url as image_url1, m2.image_url as image_url2, m3.image_url as image_url3 , a.total_count, a.total_rate, a.win_count, a.lose_count , m1.leader_id as leader_id, ml1.type as leader_type, ml1.stat as leader_stat , ml1.increase_by as leader_increase_by, ml1.icon_path as leader_icon , get_leader_skill_desc(ml1.type, ml1.stat, ml1.increase_by) as leader_skill_description from ( select monster_id_1, monster_id_2, monster_id_3 , count(1) as total_count , ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN bll.win_lose = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) as total_rate , sum(case when bll.win_lose = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as win_count , sum(case when bll.win_lose = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as lose_count from ( select vbdi.match_id, vbdi.log_timestamp, vbdi.type , coalesce(mcm1.original_monster_id, vbdi.monster_id_1) AS monster_id_1 , least(coalesce(mcm2.original_monster_id, vbdi.monster_id_2), coalesce(mcm3.original_monster_id, vbdi.monster_id_3)) AS monster_id_2 , greatest(coalesce(mcm2.original_monster_id, vbdi.monster_id_2), coalesce(mcm3.original_monster_id, vbdi.monster_id_3)) AS monster_id_3 from view_battle_deck_info vbdi left join monster_collaboration_mapping mcm1 on vbdi.monster_id_1 = mcm1.collaboration_monster_id left join monster_collaboration_mapping mcm2 on vbdi.monster_id_2 = mcm2.collaboration_monster_id left join monster_collaboration_mapping mcm3 on vbdi.monster_id_3 = mcm3.collaboration_monster_id where vbdi.type = 'defense'
AND vbdi.monster_id_1 IN #{id}
AND LEAST(vbdi.monster_id_2, vbdi.monster_id_3) IN #{id} AND GREATEST(vbdi.monster_id_2, vbdi.monster_id_3) IN #{id}
AND (vbdi.monster_id_2 IN #{id} OR vbdi.monster_id_3 IN #{id})
AND (vbdi.monster_id_2 IN #{id} OR vbdi.monster_id_3 IN #{id})
AND vbdi.match_id = #{match_id}
) vbdi left join battle_log_list bll ON vbdi.match_id = bll.match_id AND vbdi.log_timestamp = bll.log_timestamp
left join monster sm1 on vbdi.monster_id_1 = sm1.monster_id left join monster sm2 on vbdi.monster_id_2 = sm2.monster_id left join monster sm3 on vbdi.monster_id_3 = sm3.monster_id
where 1=1
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guild_siege_battle_log gsbl WHERE gsbl.guild_id = #{view_guild_id}::text AND gsbl.match_id = bll.match_id)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guild_siege_battle_log gsbl WHERE gsbl.guild_id = #{sess_guild_id}::text AND gsbl.match_id = bll.match_id)
AND ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guild_siege_season WHERE end_date IS NULL) = 0 OR SUBSTRING(bll.match_id, 1, 6) >= (SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', gss.start_date), 'YYYYMM') FROM guild_siege_season gss WHERE gss.end_date IS NULL ORDER BY gss.season_no DESC LIMIT 1) )
AND bll.opp_guild_id IN #{guild_id}
AND sm1.star <= 4 AND sm2.star <= 4 AND sm3.star <= 4
AND (sm1.star >= 5 OR sm2.star >= 5 OR sm3.star >= 5)
group by monster_id_1, monster_id_2, monster_id_3
having SUM(CASE WHEN bll.win_lose = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= #{min_lose_count}::int
order by total_count desc limit CAST(#{paging} AS bigint) offset CAST(#{paging} AS bigint) * (CAST(#{offset} AS bigint) - 1) ) a LEFT JOIN monster m1 ON a.monster_id_1 = m1.monster_id LEFT JOIN monster m2 ON a.monster_id_2 = m2.monster_id LEFT JOIN monster m3 ON a.monster_id_3 = m3.monster_id LEFT JOIN monster_leaders ml1 ON m1.leader_id = ml1.leader_id order by total_count desc

v.def_monster_3 = srad.def_monster_3 AND v.vote_type = 'UP') + (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM siege_deck_user_vote v WHERE v.deck_id IS NULL AND v.def_monster_1 = srad.def_monster_1 AND v.def_monster_2 = srad.def_monster_2 AND v.def_monster_3 = srad.def_monster_3 AND v.vote_type = 'UP' AND ( SELECT array_agg(u ORDER BY u) FROM unnest(ARRAY[ COALESCE((SELECT mcm.original_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping mcm WHERE mcm.collaboration_monster_id = TRIM(v.atk_monster_1::text) LIMIT 1), TRIM(v.atk_monster_1::text)), COALESCE((SELECT mcm.original_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping mcm WHERE mcm.collaboration_monster_id = TRIM(v.atk_monster_2::text) LIMIT 1), TRIM(v.atk_monster_2::text)), COALESCE((SELECT mcm.original_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping mcm WHERE mcm.collaboration_monster_id = TRIM(v.atk_monster_3::text) LIMIT 1), TRIM(v.atk_monster_3::text)) ]::text[]) AS t(u) ) = ( SELECT array_agg(u ORDER BY u) FROM unnest(ARRAY[ COALESCE((SELECT mcm.original_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping mcm WHERE mcm.collaboration_monster_id = TRIM(srad.atk_monster_1::text) LIMIT 1), TRIM(srad.atk_monster_1::text)), COALESCE((SELECT mcm.original_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping mcm WHERE mcm.collaboration_monster_id = TRIM(srad.atk_monster_2::text) LIMIT 1), TRIM(srad.atk_monster_2::text)), COALESCE((SELECT mcm.original_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping mcm WHERE mcm.collaboration_monster_id = TRIM(srad.atk_monster_3::text) LIMIT 1), TRIM(srad.atk_monster_3::text)) ]::text[]) AS t(u) ) ) ) AS recommend_count , ( (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM siege_deck_user_vote v WHERE v.deck_id = srad.id AND v.def_monster_1 = srad.def_monster_1 AND v.def_monster_2 = srad.def_monster_2 AND v.def_monster_3 = srad.def_monster_3 AND v.vote_type = 'DOWN') + (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM siege_deck_user_vote v WHERE v.deck_id IS NULL AND v.def_monster_1 = srad.def_monster_1 AND v.def_monster_2 = srad.def_monster_2 AND v.def_monster_3 = srad.def_monster_3 AND v.vote_type = 'DOWN' AND ( SELECT array_agg(u ORDER BY u) FROM unnest(ARRAY[ COALESCE((SELECT mcm.original_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping mcm WHERE mcm.collaboration_monster_id = TRIM(v.atk_monster_1::text) LIMIT 1), TRIM(v.atk_monster_1::text)), COALESCE((SELECT mcm.original_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping mcm WHERE mcm.collaboration_monster_id = TRIM(v.atk_monster_2::text) LIMIT 1), TRIM(v.atk_monster_2::text)), COALESCE((SELECT mcm.original_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping mcm WHERE mcm.collaboration_monster_id = TRIM(v.atk_monster_3::text) LIMIT 1), TRIM(v.atk_monster_3::text)) ]::text[]) AS t(u) ) = ( SELECT array_agg(u ORDER BY u) FROM unnest(ARRAY[ COALESCE((SELECT mcm.original_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping mcm WHERE mcm.collaboration_monster_id = TRIM(srad.atk_monster_1::text) LIMIT 1), TRIM(srad.atk_monster_1::text)), COALESCE((SELECT mcm.original_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping mcm WHERE mcm.collaboration_monster_id = TRIM(srad.atk_monster_2::text) LIMIT 1), TRIM(srad.atk_monster_2::text)), COALESCE((SELECT mcm.original_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping mcm WHERE mcm.collaboration_monster_id = TRIM(srad.atk_monster_3::text) LIMIT 1), TRIM(srad.atk_monster_3::text)) ]::text[]) AS t(u) ) ) ) AS not_recommend_count from siege_recommended_attack_deck srad LEFT JOIN monster m1 ON srad.atk_monster_1 = m1.monster_id LEFT JOIN monster m2 ON srad.atk_monster_2 = m2.monster_id LEFT JOIN monster m3 ON srad.atk_monster_3 = m3.monster_id where srad.def_monster_1 = #{dm1} and srad.def_monster_2 = #{dm2} and srad.def_monster_3 = #{dm3} order /* selectRecordList - 본인 길드 인원만 */ select wizard_id , wizard_name , total_count , win_count , lose_count , round(win_count::numeric / total_count * 100, 2) as total_rate from (select wizard_id , wizard_name , count(case when win_lose = '1' then 1 end) as win_count , count(case when win_lose = '2' then 1 end) as lose_count , count(1) as total_count from battle_log_list bll where 1 = 1
AND bll.guild_id = #{sess_guild_id}::text
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM guild_siege_season gss WHERE gss.season_no = #{season_no}::int AND TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(bll.match_id, 1, 6), 'YYYYMM') >= gss.start_date AND (gss.end_date IS NULL OR TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(bll.match_id, 1, 6), 'YYYYMM') <= gss.end_date) )
group by wizard_id , wizard_name ) bllb order by win_count desc

/* selectGuildSiegeHistorySimple - 기본 형태 + 길드별 통계 */ WITH base_matches AS ( -- 성능 개선: match_id를 먼저 페이징으로 줄인 뒤 통계를 계산 SELECT match_id, COUNT(DISTINCT guild_id) as guild_count FROM guild_siege_battle_log WHERE 1 = 1
AND match_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT match_id FROM guild_siege_battle_log WHERE guild_id = #{view_guild_id}::text )
AND match_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT match_id FROM guild_siege_battle_log WHERE guild_id = #{sess_guild_id}::text )
AND ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guild_siege_season WHERE end_date IS NULL) = 0 OR TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(match_id, 1, 6), 'YYYYMM') >= (SELECT start_date FROM guild_siege_season WHERE end_date IS NULL ORDER BY season_no DESC LIMIT 1) )
GROUP BY match_id HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT guild_id) = 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT match_rank) = 2) /* 1대1 레전드 토너먼트 */ OR (COUNT(DISTINCT guild_id) = 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT match_rank) = 3) /* 3파전 일반 점령전 */ ORDER BY match_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}::bigint
OFFSET (#{page}::bigint - 1) * #{limit}::bigint
OFFSET #{offset}::bigint
), guild_ranked AS ( SELECT gsbl.match_id, gsbl.guild_id, gsbl.guild_name, gsbl.rating_id, gsbl.match_rank, bm.guild_count FROM guild_siege_battle_log gsbl INNER JOIN base_matches bm ON gsbl.match_id = bm.match_id ), guild_stats AS ( -- 성능 개선: view_battle_deck_info 조인 제거 (UI에서 쓰는 값은 battle_log_list만으로 계산 가능) SELECT gr.match_id, gr.guild_id, COUNT(1) as total_attack_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN bll.win_lose = '1' THEN 1 END) as attack_win_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN bll.win_lose = '1' THEN 1 END)::numeric / COUNT(1)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as attack_rate, -- 기존 화면 표시와 동일하게 방성률도 동일 기준으로 집계 (공격 로그 기반) COUNT(1) as total_defense_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN bll.win_lose = '1' THEN 1 END) as defense_win_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN bll.win_lose = '1' THEN 1 END)::numeric / COUNT(1)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as defense_rate, (3 * COUNT(1)) as total_monster_count, COUNT(1) as available_attack_count FROM guild_ranked gr LEFT JOIN battle_log_list bll ON gr.match_id = bll.match_id AND gr.guild_id = bll.guild_id GROUP BY gr.match_id, gr.guild_id ) SELECT gr.match_id, -- 각 순위별 길드 정보를 개별 컬럼으로 MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '1' THEN gr.guild_name END) as guild_1st, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '1' THEN gr.guild_id END) as guild_id_1st, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '1' THEN gr.rating_id END) as rating_1st, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '1' THEN COALESCE(gs1.attack_rate, 0) END) as attack_rate_1st, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '1' THEN COALESCE(gs1.attack_win_count, 0) END) as attack_win_count_1st, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '1' THEN COALESCE(gs1.total_attack_count, 0) END) as total_attack_count_1st, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '1' THEN COALESCE(gs1.defense_rate, 0) END) as defense_rate_1st, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '1' THEN COALESCE(gs1.defense_win_count, 0) END) as defense_win_count_1st, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '1' THEN COALESCE(gs1.total_defense_count, 0) END) as total_defense_count_1st, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '1' THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(gs1.available_attack_count, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(gs1.total_monster_count, 0)::numeric / gs1.available_attack_count::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END END) as monster_usage_rate_1st, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '1' THEN COALESCE(gs1.total_monster_count, 0) END) as unique_monster_deck_count_1st, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '1' THEN COALESCE(gs1.available_attack_count, 0) END) as available_attack_count_1st, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '2' THEN gr.guild_name END) as guild_2nd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '2' THEN gr.guild_id END) as guild_id_2nd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '2' THEN gr.rating_id END) as rating_2nd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '2' THEN COALESCE(gs2.attack_rate, 0) END) as attack_rate_2nd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '2' THEN COALESCE(gs2.attack_win_count, 0) END) as attack_win_count_2nd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '2' THEN COALESCE(gs2.total_attack_count, 0) END) as total_attack_count_2nd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '2' THEN COALESCE(gs2.defense_rate, 0) END) as defense_rate_2nd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '2' THEN COALESCE(gs2.defense_win_count, 0) END) as defense_win_count_2nd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '2' THEN COALESCE(gs2.total_defense_count, 0) END) as total_defense_count_2nd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '2' THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(gs2.available_attack_count, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(gs2.total_monster_count, 0)::numeric / gs2.available_attack_count::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END END) as monster_usage_rate_2nd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '2' THEN COALESCE(gs2.total_monster_count, 0) END) as unique_monster_deck_count_2nd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '2' THEN COALESCE(gs2.available_attack_count, 0) END) as available_attack_count_2nd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '3' THEN gr.guild_name END) as guild_3rd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '3' THEN gr.guild_id END) as guild_id_3rd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '3' THEN gr.rating_id END) as rating_3rd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '3' THEN COALESCE(gs3.attack_rate, 0) END) as attack_rate_3rd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '3' THEN COALESCE(gs3.attack_win_count, 0) END) as attack_win_count_3rd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '3' THEN COALESCE(gs3.total_attack_count, 0) END) as total_attack_count_3rd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '3' THEN COALESCE(gs3.defense_rate, 0) END) as defense_rate_3rd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '3' THEN COALESCE(gs3.defense_win_count, 0) END) as defense_win_count_3rd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '3' THEN COALESCE(gs3.total_defense_count, 0) END) as total_defense_count_3rd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '3' THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(gs3.available_attack_count, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(gs3.total_monster_count, 0)::numeric / gs3.available_attack_count::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END END) as monster_usage_rate_3rd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '3' THEN COALESCE(gs3.total_monster_count, 0) END) as unique_monster_deck_count_3rd, MAX(CASE WHEN gr.match_rank = '3' THEN COALESCE(gs3.available_attack_count, 0) END) as available_attack_count_3rd, gr.guild_count FROM guild_ranked gr LEFT JOIN guild_stats gs1 ON gr.match_id = gs1.match_id AND gr.guild_id = gs1.guild_id AND gr.match_rank = '1' LEFT JOIN guild_stats gs2 ON gr.match_id = gs2.match_id AND gr.guild_id = gs2.guild_id AND gr.match_rank = '2' LEFT JOIN guild_stats gs3 ON gr.match_id = gs3.match_id AND gr.guild_id = gs3.guild_id AND gr.match_rank = '3' GROUP BY gr.match_id, gr.guild_count ORDER BY gr.match_id DESC

/* selectGuildSiegeHistoryCount */ SELECT COUNT(1) as total_count FROM ( SELECT match_id FROM guild_siege_battle_log WHERE 1 = 1
AND match_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT match_id FROM guild_siege_battle_log WHERE guild_id = #{view_guild_id}::text )
AND match_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT match_id FROM guild_siege_battle_log WHERE guild_id = #{sess_guild_id}::text )
AND ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guild_siege_season WHERE end_date IS NULL) = 0 OR TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(match_id, 1, 6), 'YYYYMM') >= (SELECT start_date FROM guild_siege_season WHERE end_date IS NULL ORDER BY season_no DESC LIMIT 1) )
GROUP BY match_id HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT guild_id) = 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT match_rank) = 2) /* 1대1 레전드 토너먼트 */ OR (COUNT(DISTINCT guild_id) = 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT match_rank) = 3) /* 3파전 일반 점령전 */ ) t

/* getAllRelatedMonsterIds */ WITH related_ids AS ( -- 입력된 ID가 오리지널몹인 경우 SELECT #{monster_id} as monster_id UNION ALL -- 입력된 ID의 콜라보몹들 SELECT collaboration_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping WHERE original_monster_id = #{monster_id} UNION ALL -- 입력된 ID가 콜라보몹인 경우, 해당 오리지널몹 SELECT original_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping WHERE collaboration_monster_id = #{monster_id} UNION ALL -- 입력된 ID가 콜라보몹인 경우, 같은 오리지널몹을 가진 다른 콜라보몹들 SELECT mcm2.collaboration_monster_id FROM monster_collaboration_mapping mcm1 JOIN monster_collaboration_mapping mcm2 ON mcm1.original_monster_id = mcm2.original_monster_id WHERE mcm1.collaboration_monster_id = #{monster_id} ) SELECT DISTINCT monster_id FROM related_ids WHERE monster_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: /* touchRecommendedAttackDeck - 공덱 수정일 갱신 */ UPDATE siege_recommended_attack_deck SET upt_user_id = #{sess_user_id}::text, upt_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{deck_id}::int
mapper.insert: /* upsertRecommendedAttackDeckStats - 공덱 몬스터 스탯 upsert */ INSERT INTO siege_recommended_attack_deck_stats ( deck_id, monster_id, hp, atk, def, spd, crit_rate, crit_dmg, resistance, accuracy, crt_user_id, upt_user_id ) VALUES ( #{deck_id}::int, #{monster_id}::text, #{hp}::int, #{atk}::int, #{def}::int, #{spd}::int, #{crit_rate}::int, #{crit_dmg}::int, #{resistance}::int, #{accuracy}::int, #{sess_user_id}::text, #{sess_user_id}::text ) ON CONFLICT (deck_id, monster_id) DO UPDATE SET hp = EXCLUDED.hp, atk = EXCLUDED.atk, def = EXCLUDED.def, spd = EXCLUDED.spd, crit_rate = EXCLUDED.crit_rate, crit_dmg = EXCLUDED.crit_dmg, resistance = EXCLUDED.resistance, accuracy = EXCLUDED.accuracy, upt_user_id = EXCLUDED.upt_user_id, upt_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: /* selectCurrentSeason - 시작일~종료일(종료일 없으면 금일) 사이에 오늘 포함되는 시즌, 없으면 최신 시즌 */ SELECT season_no, start_date, end_date FROM ( SELECT 1 AS ord, season_no, start_date, end_date FROM guild_siege_season WHERE start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY season_no DESC LIMIT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS ord, season_no, start_date, end_date FROM guild_siege_season ORDER BY season_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) x ORDER BY ord LIMIT 1

/* selectSeasonList - 시즌 목록 (드롭다운용) */ SELECT season_no, start_date, end_date, TO_CHAR(start_date, 'YYYY-MM') as start_yyyymm, TO_CHAR(COALESCE(end_date, CURRENT_DATE), 'YYYY-MM') as end_yyyymm FROM guild_siege_season ORDER BY season_no DESC

/* selectMonsterInfo - 몬스터 기본 정보 조회 */ SELECT m.monster_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name, m.un_name, m.star_type, m.star, m.arousal_type, m.image_url, m.leader_id, m.swarfarm_id, m.com2us_id, m.family_id, m.skill_group_id, m.archetype, m.base_stars, m.natural_stars, m.obtainable, m.can_awaken, m.awaken_level, m.awaken_bonus, m.skill_ups_to_max, m.fusion_food, m.homunculus, -- 기본 스탯 m.base_hp, m.base_attack, m.base_defense, m.speed, m.crit_rate, m.crit_damage, m.resistance, m.accuracy, m.raw_hp, m.raw_attack, m.raw_defense, m.max_lvl_hp, m.max_lvl_attack, m.max_lvl_defense, -- 리더 스킬 정보 ml.leader_id as leader_skill_id, ml.type as leader_type, ml.stat as leader_stat, ml.increase_by as leader_increase_by, ml.icon_path as leader_icon, get_leader_skill_desc(ml.type, ml.stat, ml.increase_by) as leader_skill_description FROM monster m LEFT JOIN monster_leaders ml ON m.leader_id = ml.leader_id WHERE m.monster_id = #{monster_id}

/* selectMonstersByFamilyId - 몬스터 상세용 패밀리 전체 (목록 API와 별도) */ SELECT m.monster_id , m.kr_name , m.un_name , m.monster_elemental , m.image_url , CAST(m.star AS INTEGER) AS star , m.archetype , m.arousal_type , CAST(m.family_id AS INTEGER) AS family_id FROM monster m WHERE m.family_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(m.family_id AS BIGINT) = CAST(#{family_id} AS BIGINT) AND m.usg_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.monster_elemental, m.monster_id

/* selectMonstersByUnName - family_id 없을 때 un_name으로 패밀리 보완 */ SELECT m.monster_id , m.kr_name , m.un_name , m.monster_elemental , m.image_url , CAST(m.star AS INTEGER) AS star , m.archetype , m.arousal_type , CAST(m.family_id AS INTEGER) AS family_id FROM monster m WHERE m.un_name IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(m.un_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(#{un_name})) AND m.usg_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.monster_elemental, m.monster_id

/* selectMonstersByEvolutionGroupKey - MonsterIdEvolutionUtil.evolutionGroupKey 와 동일 조건 */ SELECT m.monster_id , m.kr_name , m.un_name , m.monster_elemental , m.image_url , CAST(m.star AS INTEGER) AS star , m.archetype , m.arousal_type , CAST(m.family_id AS INTEGER) AS family_id FROM monster m WHERE COALESCE(m.usg_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND LENGTH(TRIM(m.monster_id)) >= 2 AND ( SUBSTRING(TRIM(m.monster_id) FROM 1 FOR LENGTH(TRIM(m.monster_id)) - 2) || SUBSTRING(TRIM(m.monster_id) FROM LENGTH(TRIM(m.monster_id)) FOR 1) ) = #{evolution_group_key} ORDER BY m.monster_elemental, m.monster_id

/* selectMonstersBySkillGroupId - 같은 스킬 그룹(다른 속성 패밀리) */ SELECT m.monster_id , m.kr_name , m.un_name , m.monster_elemental , m.image_url , CAST(m.star AS INTEGER) AS star , m.archetype , m.arousal_type , CAST(m.family_id AS INTEGER) AS family_id FROM monster m WHERE m.skill_group_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(m.skill_group_id AS BIGINT) = CAST(#{skill_group_id} AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(m.usg_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY m.monster_elemental, m.monster_id

/* selectMonsterStatCohortBounds - star + awaken digit cohort min/max */ SELECT MIN(m.max_lvl_hp) FILTER (WHERE m.max_lvl_hp IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_hp, MAX(m.max_lvl_hp) FILTER (WHERE m.max_lvl_hp IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_hp, MIN(m.max_lvl_attack) FILTER (WHERE m.max_lvl_attack IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_attack, MAX(m.max_lvl_attack) FILTER (WHERE m.max_lvl_attack IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_attack, MIN(m.max_lvl_defense) FILTER (WHERE m.max_lvl_defense IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_defense, MAX(m.max_lvl_defense) FILTER (WHERE m.max_lvl_defense IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_defense, MIN(m.speed) FILTER (WHERE m.speed IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_speed, MAX(m.speed) FILTER (WHERE m.speed IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_speed, MIN(m.crit_rate) FILTER (WHERE m.crit_rate IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_crit_rate, MAX(m.crit_rate) FILTER (WHERE m.crit_rate IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_crit_rate, MIN(m.crit_damage) FILTER (WHERE m.crit_damage IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_crit_damage, MAX(m.crit_damage) FILTER (WHERE m.crit_damage IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_crit_damage, MIN(m.resistance) FILTER (WHERE m.resistance IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_resistance, MAX(m.resistance) FILTER (WHERE m.resistance IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_resistance, MIN(m.accuracy) FILTER (WHERE m.accuracy IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_accuracy, MAX(m.accuracy) FILTER (WHERE m.accuracy IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_accuracy, MIN(m.skill_ups_to_max) FILTER (WHERE m.skill_ups_to_max IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_skill_ups, MAX(m.skill_ups_to_max) FILTER (WHERE m.skill_ups_to_max IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_skill_ups FROM monster m WHERE m.usg_yn = 'Y' AND CAST(COALESCE(m.star, 0) AS INTEGER) = #{star} AND LENGTH(TRIM(m.monster_id)) >= 2 AND SUBSTRING(TRIM(m.monster_id) FROM LENGTH(TRIM(m.monster_id)) - 1 FOR 1) ~ '^[0-9]$' AND CAST(SUBSTRING(TRIM(m.monster_id) FROM LENGTH(TRIM(m.monster_id)) - 1 FOR 1) AS INTEGER) = #{awaken_digit}

/* selectMonsterSkills - 몬스터 스킬 목록 (monster_skill_link + skill_master) */ SELECT ms.monster_id, ms.skill_id, ms.skill_order, sm.skill_id AS skill_detail_id, sm.swarfarm_id, sm.com2us_id, sm.name AS skill_name, sm.description AS skill_description, sm.slot, sm.cooltime, sm.hits, sm.passive, sm.aoe, sm.random, sm.max_level, sm.multiplier_formula, sm.multiplier_formula_raw, sm.scales_with, sm.icon_filename, sm.icon_path, sm.level_progress_description, sm.other_skill_id, sm.swarfarm_url, sm.remark FROM public.monster_skill_link ms INNER JOIN public.skill_master sm ON sm.skill_id = ms.skill_id WHERE ms.monster_id = #{monster_id} ORDER BY sm.slot ASC NULLS LAST, ms.skill_order ASC

/* selectMonsterSkillEffects - 스킬 이펙트 + skill_effect_master 아이콘 monster_skill_link에 동일 skill_id가 여러 행이면 이펙트 행이 중복되므로 링크는 skill_id당 1행만 사용 */ SELECT se.skill_id, se.effect_id, se.effect_order, se.effect_name, se.effect_type, se.effect_description, se.is_buff, se.chance, sem.icon_path AS effect_icon_path, sem.icon_filename AS effect_icon_filename, sem.swarfarm_url AS effect_swarfarm_url, sem.remark AS effect_remark FROM public.skill_effects se INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (ms.skill_id) ms.skill_id, ms.skill_order FROM public.monster_skill_link ms INNER JOIN public.skill_master sm ON sm.skill_id = ms.skill_id WHERE ms.monster_id = #{monster_id} ORDER BY ms.skill_id, sm.slot ASC NULLS LAST, ms.skill_order ASC ) msl ON msl.skill_id = se.skill_id LEFT JOIN public.skill_master sm ON sm.skill_id = se.skill_id LEFT JOIN public.skill_effect_master sem ON sem.effect_id = se.effect_id ORDER BY sm.slot ASC NULLS LAST, msl.skill_order ASC, se.effect_order ASC
